# Anthony Tulk

## Overview

- **Age:** School-aged boy  <sub>[v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony is a schoolboy with dark, gloomy eyes. He has an impertinent, sullen swagger and a dark face.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P1](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0001), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)_

## Personality

Anthony is independent, sullen, and cheeky, holding firm opinions of his own and showing an initial disdain for female teachers. Though he acts rebellious and impudent toward authority, he is clever and capable of showing respect once earned.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P1](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0001), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005)_

- Sullen  <sub>[v2 c5 P1](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0001), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)</sub>

## History

Anthony was taken in by his aunt, Mrs. Laurence Tulk, and enrolled in Brierley school. He joined the Regent's entrance class under Miss Thorne and eventually passed his Entrance examinations along with his classmates. When Nell Harcourt became the schoolteacher, Anthony initially disdained her and tested her authority, such as by putting a mouse in her desk drawer. After Nell lost her temper and whipped him, Anthony surprisingly developed a deep respect for her, stating her beating was 'just as good as a man's.'

_Sources: [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P1](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0001), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P31](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0031), [v2 c12 P48](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0048), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_
